payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the DVD identified in the source image remain identifiable in the edited image, and if so, what color is that same DVD?
node.criteria: Compare the source DVD in its small rectangular case near the center with the edited image. Complete only if the same DVD is identifiable and white. Partial if that same DVD is identifiable and has changed from black toward white but is not white. Absent if the same DVD is identifiable and remains black with no requested color change. Unknown if its identity or color cannot be established across the images; do not count a separate white disc as the transformed DVD without visual evidence linking it to the source DVD.
node.binding: Target: the small rectangular DVD case near the center of the source image, containing the dark DVD. Track that same DVD across source and edited images using its location and case context; do not bind to an unrelated white disc.

outcome.description: Change the DVD from black to white.
